scheme_name: West Bengal Transport Workers’ Social Security Scheme: Assistance for Marriage
other_conditions: Applicant must be between 18 and 60 years of age at the time of enrolment.
Applicant must be an unorganized worker employed in the operation of commercial vehicles.
Vehicle must be used for commercial purposes and not solely for personal or family use.
Maximum of two beneficiaries per family.
Benefit is provided for the marriage of the beneficiary or their dependent children.
benefits_summary: Provides ₹10,000 for the marriage of the beneficiary and an additional ₹10,000 for each of up to two dependent children.
